actions.why: The plan gives CooLinens the higher slot and has Sleephoria holding during CooLinens' push weeks, but Sleephoria is out-bidding CooLinens on 'cooling sheets queen' now.
actions.evidence: 13–20 Oct on 'cooling sheets queen': Sleephoria 20 clicks, 3 orders at +145–160% Top-of-Search; CooLinens 16, 0. On 20–21 Oct Sleephoria took 1 click and CooLinens 10 (1 order); Sleephoria's +145% bid is still set.
actions.expected: CooLinens' Queen push reads cleanly; the two brands stop paying each other's top-of-search price.
actions.check: The plan's proposed read: CooLinens' top-of-search CPC, impression share and clicks on shared vs unshared searches.
actions.safe: Sleephoria keeps its rest-of-search presence and its own push weeks.

actions.action: Stop two Queen tails from catching the head keywords
actions.change: Queen Tail 18: add negative exact 'cooling sheets queen'. Queen Tail 22: add negative exact 'cooling queen sheets'.
actions.why: Amazon matches the tail keywords 'cool sheet queen' and 'cool queen sheet' to the head searches, so part of the head traffic runs at the tail's bid and objective instead of the ranking campaign's.
actions.evidence: 4 of 16 clicks on 'cooling sheets queen' and 1 of 2 on 'cooling queen sheets' went to the tails.
actions.expected: All head-keyword clicks route through the ranking campaign; the tails keep their own searches.
actions.check: Next search-term report: the tails no longer serve the head terms but still serve 'cool sheet queen'.
actions.safe: Same shoppers, same ad. Only the campaign that buys the click changes.

actions.change: New Sponsored Products exact campaign: keyword 'coolinens', advertised SKU Queen Graphite, fixed $2.14 bid, $10/day, Defensive. Add negative exact 'coolinens' in 'CooLinens Pillowcases (PAT) Defensive'.
actions.why: People searching our brand name now see pillowcase ads. The plan's branded campaign for the sheets was never launched.
actions.evidence: 7 brand clicks went to pillowcase ads, 0 orders. Sleephoria's branded exact ran at 14% ACoS and 20% CVR.
actions.expected: Brand searches land on the sheets, at about 19% ACoS (plan).
actions.safe: Brand searches are ours, so no discovery is lost.

actions.action: Negatives for searches that are not cooling sheets
actions.change: Cooling Rivals Queen/King/Twin (product targeting): negative exact silk bed sheets, tencel lyocell sheets, cooling comforter set, cooling blanket for bed, cooling blankets for hot sleepers, below zero cooling comforter, slumber cloud ultracool comforter, apartment essentials men, sleep number bed sheets. Negative phrase 'sleephoria' in the rival-page campaigns and Auto. Auto: negative exact bed cooling system, electronic cooling for menopause, under sheets bed fan.
actions.why: These searches are for other products or for our own sister brand. Relevance decides this, not click counts, so there is no need to wait.
actions.expected: Saves roughly $5–8 a day. No relevant traffic is blocked: 'nylon spandex sheets', 'cooling sheets' and rival brand searches stay open.
actions.safe: Only clearly unrelated searches are blocked.

actions.action: Hold the Cal King push until the bridge lands (plan option B)
actions.change: Do not open the Cal King push on Oct 26. Keep Cal King on its profit tail campaign; build the 6 Cal King rank exacts ready to switch on when the bridge (Dec 22) restores spare stock.
actions.why: The plan's push needs spare units to carry the extra sales; Cal King's spare after the planned pushes is 2 units, and its only sellable ad colour is Graphite (72). No Cal King rank exact exists today.
actions.evidence: Plan PPC calls CL-PC3: 0 of 6 push keywords on a rank exact, spare 2 units. Live: Cal King 0.75 units a day, $3 a day of ads.
actions.expected: No stock-out from a push the stock cannot carry; the exacts are ready for the bridge.
actions.check: Bridge confirmed (CL-EC6) → open the push with the 85% entry gate.
actions.safe: Cal King is 3% of the plan's units; the plan values its push at $54k, the smallest group.

actions.action: Point the smaller sizes at the plan colours
actions.change: Full: Full Cream → Full Cool Grey (94 units, the plan colour; ~376 days of cover). Twin: Twin White → Twin Graphite (56). Cal King: Cal King Regal Purple → Cal King Graphite (72).
actions.why: The live colours are among the weakest sellers for the sister brand, and Full Cream and Cal King Regal Purple have only ~30 units each. Full Midnight Black sells best organically but runs out ~Dec 4 at the plan's push pace (plan stock board), and the plan runs no ads on colours that run out before the bridge.
actions.evidence: Plan's Q4 board lists Full Cool Grey, Twin Graphite and Cal King Graphite among 'the colours to advertise now'; Full Midnight Black is on its 'run out before the bridge' list.
actions.expected: Better conversion from the same clicks, and no stock-out risk behind the ads.
actions.safe: Same keywords, bids and budgets; small sizes on capped spend.

actions.why: King is part of the plan's light push (35% since Oct 19) and is outselling Queen 2.6×, but most of its ad orders came on one day: 9 of 13 SP orders on 18 Oct.
actions.evidence: King SP 16–20 Oct: 163 clicks, 15 orders, ACoS 46%. King units 4, 10, 19, 4, 11 vs a 4.3 baseline.
actions.expected: A full week shows whether King holds.
actions.check: 27 Oct: King ACoS vs the plan's 39.1% refund-adjusted line with orders on 4+ of 7 days, plus rank held. This is also King's light-push read for the push-cost calibration (CL-PU8).

actions.action: Keep the plan's live tests running: rival pages, Display, SB collections, rival videos, Auto
actions.why: These are Joseph's deliberate tests ('test now, as profit lanes'). The plan reads each at two weeks with 3+ clicks a day per target and a stop-loss at 2× break-even (CL-PC5).
actions.evidence: SB collections: Queen 2 orders on 13 clicks, King 2 on 12 (ACoS 30–34%). King rival video 3 on 16 (24%). Queen rival video 0 on 23 (15% chance at 8%). Auto $11.69, 15 clicks. Rival pages moved to A9.
actions.expected: A fair read at the gates.
actions.check: Two-week read (~Oct 30–Nov 1) per the plan's PC3/PC8 rules; video ads also on 26 Oct (new video).

actions.action: Decide the rival-page test early: stop-loss now or a lower bid to the two-week read
actions.change: Option 1 (stop-loss): pause the five 'Cooling Rivals' product-targeting campaigns (Queen, King, Full, Twin, Cal King); keep the own-page defence (CooLinens Pillowcases PAT). Option 2: cut their bids by about 30% (from ~$2.20 CPC) and read at two weeks (~Oct 30). Either way, apply the A5 relevance negatives.
actions.why: This is one of Joseph's deliberate tests, read at two weeks with a stop-loss at 2× break-even (CL-PC5). It has reached the click gate early, so the call is his.
actions.evidence: 16–21 Oct: 47 clicks, 0 orders, $105.39. 0 orders on 47 clicks happens about 5% of the time at 6% CVR and 1% at the plan's 8.8%. They also serve on unrelated searches (silk, tencel, comforters).
actions.expected: Option 1 saves about $18/day; option 2 about $5/day while keeping the read.
actions.check: Joseph's answer; if no answer, read again at 60 clicks.
actions.safe: Rival pages are a test lane, not a ranking lane; no push keyword depends on them.
